data: NVIDIA's net income rose from $9,752 million in fiscal 2022 (the year ended January 30, 2022) to $29,760 million in fiscal 2024 (the year ended January 28, 2024). That is an increase of $20,008 million, or about 205.2%, so fiscal 2024 net income was roughly 3.05 times the fiscal 2022 level. The rise was not steady: net income fell to $4,368 million in fiscal 2023, partly because of a $1,353 million acquisition termination cost, and then jumped in fiscal 2024 as revenue grew to $60,922 million.
